Week 12 has arrived!

We are going to begin three weeks of study of neural networks. We will begin by learning the simplest neural network architecture, the multi-layer perceptron, and about common
techniques for fitting neural networks and the key hyperparameters, such as optimization algorithms, learning rate, dropout, activation functions, and more. 
We will talk about the data requirements for
neural networks and the types of problems which they are best suited for. We will begin discussing alternative architectures, starting with convolutional neural nets.

If you have not contacted me with your group to schedule your MVP demo please do so immediately.


You can read more about the plan for the week and the reading/resources in [Module 12](../modules/module12.qmd).

[Lab 7](../assignments/labs/lab7.qmd) is available, due Sunday May 3rd at midnight.
